reason: Examined def-additive-cocontinuous-module-functor (in-run level-0), def-left-exact-and-right-exact-functor, thm-small-colimits-from-coproducts-and-coequalizers, cor-in-a-preadditive-category-the-coequalizer-of-a-parallel-pair-is-the-cokernel-of-their-difference, thm-an-additive-functor-preserves-finite-biproducts, thm-modules-over-a-ring-form-an-abelian-category, thm-rmod-is-complete-and-cocomplete. Verified the construction of small colimits from coproducts and coequalizers applies, that the coequalizer used is the cokernel of a difference and hence preserved by right exactness, and that additive functors preserve finite biproducts so cokernel preservation equals right exactness for this class. Kamensky p.53 records both equivalences (colimits ⇔ quotients + direct sums).
